name: Freelancer.com (local jobs)
summary: Global freelance marketplace whose API can post 'Local Jobs' projects pinned to a place (country, city, latitude and longitude) in job types such as Inspections, Local Job, Photography and Video Tours. Freelancers bid; the buyer awards a bid and pays through Milestone Payments released on approval. The User Agreement (s.33) forbids automated access, including the API, without Freelancer's express written permission.
short: Post a local job anywhere; nearby freelancers bid to go and do it.

pricing.model: bid-based; buyer sets a budget range, freelancers bid
pricing.notes: from_usd 0 means not published (set by bids). Posting is free. Employer fee on award: 3% or USD 3, whichever is greater (fixed price); 3% of each payment (hourly); refundable if cancelled within 7 days. Card, PayPal or Skrill: USD 0.30 + 2.3% (not for Australian transactions, which carry an Account Admin Fee of AUD 0.75 + 0.99%). Milestone arbitration: USD 5 or 5%, whichever is greater, per party, refunded to the winner. Optional upgrades include IP Agreement (USD 22.99 in the fee table, USD 21.99 in the same page's FAQ), NDA USD 22.99, Urgent USD 10.99.

latency.typical: Not published; posting, review, bidding, then award
latency.notes: No SLA. API-posted projects usually enter a review queue before they go live (developer docs, sandbox page). Active projects on 2026-10-26 via the public API: Inspections 17, Local Job 89, Photo Anywhere 0.

coverage.notes: Freelancer says Local Jobs 'get help in any location, anywhere in the world' and claims a 'talent pool of over 90.5 million professionals'. 167 of 3,487 job types are local. Active Inspections and Local Job projects on 2026-10-26 were concentrated in Thailand, the US, South Korea, Brazil and the UK, with a few in about 20 other countries. Density per city is not published. People barred under Australian or other applicable law may not use the site.

licensing.summary: No default clause transfers ownership of project deliverables to the buyer; a paid IP Agreement upgrade 'ensures intellectual property rights transfer to you' (Fees and Charges). Freelancer takes a broad, sublicensable, irrevocable licence to User Content (User Agreement s.10). The terms do not mention AI or machine-learning training or resale. Freelancer may record in-app audio and video calls for 'quality assurance, training, and service improvement' (s.15), without saying whether that means model training.

human.method: Optional 'Verified by Freelancer' KYC: government photo ID, a photo holding the ID beside a one-time keycode, and two proofs of address, reviewed by Freelancer's team. Freelancer can also demand ID at any time (s.14).
human.unknown: Verification is optional for sellers, so the freelancer you award may be unverified. Freelancer states it 'cannot and do[es] not confirm each User's purported identity' (s.38).

application.unknown: Freelancers upload files they captured however they like; there is no capture app.

camera.unknown: Nothing stops a gallery upload, screenshot or generated image.

time.unknown: No capture timestamp is checked; only message and upload times exist.

location.unknown: The project has a location, but where a file was captured is not checked. OAuth scopes fln:location_tracking_create/view ('location information of freelancer working on project') exist, but no endpoint using them is documented.

content.method: The buyer reviews the work and releases the Milestone Payment; disputes go to Freelancer's Milestone Dispute Resolution, with paid arbitration on submitted evidence.
content.unknown: Freelancer does not review deliverables, and for Local Jobs it does not verify credentials or statements of capability (s.16).

corroboration.unknown: No independent check. A buyer could award the same task to a second freelancer by hand.

auth.how_to_get: Personal Access Token: Generate Token at https://accounts.freelancer.com/settings/develop. Acts only as the account that made it; one active token per environment; valid 30 days. Sandbox tokens (https://accounts.freelancer-sandbox.com/settings/develop) work only on https://www.freelancer-sandbox.com. User Agreement s.33 bars automated means, "including ... access to our API", "without our express written permission"; the API T&Cs (apiterms) govern API use, and issuing a token may count as that permission, which is unconfirmed. Marked false until a person decides.

Create a client application at https://accounts.freelancer.com ('Develop with Freelancer.com'); applications are reviewed (expect a reply within 5 business days), and requests for single-user apps are denied. Authorization-code flow: https://accounts.freelancer.com/oauth/authorize with scope=basic and advanced_scopes as numeric ids; token at https://accounts.freelancer.com/oauth/token with a client secret. Access tokens last 30 days, with refresh tokens.

endpoints.notes: Public, no key. Filter local:true for local job ids (e.g. 867 Inspections, 1386 Local Job, 27 Photography, 1502 Video Tours, 2622 Investigation).
Public, no key. Shows current local demand; not a capture.

endpoints.params: title, description, currency, budget, jobs (a local job), local: true, location {country, city, latitude, longitude}
endpoints.notes: Scopes basic + fln:project_create. Posting is free; projects usually enter a review queue before going live.
Freelancers' bids (amount, period) on your project.
Awards the bid; the 3% employer fee is charged at award.
Scope fln:project_manage. Creates a Milestone Payment; PUT /projects/0.1/milestones/{milestone_id}/ with action=release pays the freelancer.
Scope basic. Project details and status.

api.rate_limits: Per endpoint; HTTP 429 when exceeded. RateLimit-Limit and RateLimit-Remaining headers report the windows (documented example: 50 per 60 s and 1000 per 3600 s).

mcp.community: io.github.godesigntech/freelancer-mcp-server (seller side: search, bid, message; does not post projects)
mcp.notes: No first-party MCP server found. The MCP Registry search for 'freelancer' returns only unrelated or community servers.

api.notes: The developer docs render only with JavaScript. Freelancer lists 'Local Jobs' as a common integration type; automatic bidders, spammy and 'replacement' integrations are prohibited. No OAuth protected-resource or authorization-server metadata is published.

delivery.basis: Freelancer publishes no delivery time; each freelancer's bid states a period in days. Projects usually pass a review queue before bidding opens.

payment.notes: Buyers fund their Freelancer account (credit card, PayPal, Skrill or bank deposit) and pay through Milestone Payments held in the account until released. The API can create and release milestones (scope fln:project_manage), but s.33 requires Freelancer's written permission for any API use.

requester.checks: Users must be 16 or older, able to contract and not barred by law. Freelancer may refuse any registration, request ID at any time (s.14), and usually reviews new projects before they go live. A Local Jobs buyer must give the job's location and must not put personal details (name, street number, phone, email) in the public project description.
requester.unknown: No documented check on whether a local job targets or follows a specific person.
